updateDescription.message: Quick Reply Meet has been completely rebuilt from scratch to bring more stability, performance, and modernity. This was the first extension I ever created. Now, 4 years later, I've applied all the knowledge I've gained over that time to deliver a renewed experience, aligned with Google's Material Design 3 Expressive and with some new features. I hope you like it!
